title: Trustworthy AI Teammates for Software Engineering: A Research Agenda for Lifecycle Context, Explainability, and Agentic Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2611.21624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models are rapidly changing software engineering (SE) practice by supporting code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and program comprehension. Yet most current AI coding assistants remain reactive tools: they respond to local prompts, rely on limited context, and provide suggestions whose rationale is often difficult for developers to inspect. This paper argues that the next phase of AI-assisted SE requires a shift from coding assistants to trustworthy AI teammates. We present a research agenda for human-AI co-evolution in SE, organized around three requirements. First, AI systems must become lifecycle-aware, reasoning across requirements and other deployment artifacts rather than isolated files or prompts. Second, they must provide principled explanations that expose assumptions, evidence, trade-offs, and risks in ways that support developer judgment. translated_title: 面向软件工程的可信AI队友：关于生命周期上下文、可解释性与智能体协作的研究议程
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正在通过支持代码生成、测试、调试、文档编写和程序理解，迅速改变软件工程（SE）的实践方式。然而，当前大多数AI编程助手仍然是被动式工具：它们只响应局部提示、依赖有限的上下文，且其建议背后的理据往往难以被开发者检验。本文认为，AI辅助软件工程的下一阶段需要实现从编程助手到可信AI队友的转变。我们提出了一个关于软件工程中人机协同演进的研究议程，围绕三项要求展开：第一，AI系统必须具备生命周期感知能力，能够跨越需求及其他部署制品进行推理，而非局限于孤立的文件或提示；第二，它们必须提供有原则的解释，以支持开发者判断的方式揭示假设、证据、权衡与风险；第三，它们必须支持智能体协作（agentic collaboration）……
tldr: 该论文提出AI辅助软件工程的下一阶段应从被动式编程助手转向可信AI队友，并围绕生命周期感知、有原则的可解释性和智能体协作三大要求构建人机协同演进的研究议程。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that AI-assisted software engineering must shift from reactive coding assistants to trustworthy AI teammates, proposing a research agenda for human-AI co-evolution built on three requirements: lifecycle awareness, principled explainability, and agentic collaboration.
